tools.name: list_states
tools.description: Every jurisdiction InCorp serves (50 states, DC, Puerto Rico, US Virgin Islands) with the registered agent price, formation state filing fees by entity type and the page URLs. Use get_state for the full record.

tools.name: get_state
tools.description: One jurisdiction in full: filing agency links, statutory fees with citations and review status (formation by entity type, registered agent change, name reservation, foreign qualification, dissolution, reinstatement, amendment, merger, conversion), state filing-office holidays, statute excerpts, FAQs

tools.name: get_service_pricing
tools.description: InCorp services with current list prices in USD (from the InSys pricing table) and the service page catalog. State filing fees are additional and never discounted. Optional filter by keyword.

tools.name: registered_agent_coverage
tools.description: Registered agent service by jurisdiction: annual price, office locality and the state registered agent change fee by entity type (cited). Pass a state for one record, omit it for all 53.

tools.name: incorp_holidays
tools.description: InCorp office closures (coming up), the federal holidays with observed dates by year and whether InCorp is closed, and state-specific filing-office holidays. Optional state filter.

tools.name: search_articles
tools.description: Keyword search over InCorp Knowledge Base and BizTips articles (title and description). Returns title, URL, description, dates. Cite the URL when you use an article.
